defaults.style_guide: Use stylish and enthusiastic language. Focus on beauty, transformation, and self-care. Use emojis.
examples: New season, new look! 💇‍♀️ Book your appointment for a fresh cut today.
Self-care Sunday isn't complete without a mani-pedi. 💅 Treat yourself!
Love your hair, love yourself. ✨ Come in for a gloss treatment and shine bright.
